Travel

Getting to Rewa

Many of you will be travelling through Delhi, so we have started there. Schedules change, so please confirm timings before you book.

Delhi to Rewa Airport (REW)

Direct flights run between Delhi and Rewa a few days a week, and the flight takes roughly two hours. The airport is in Chorhata, around 11 km from the city centre, with taxis and auto rickshaws into town.

Anand Vihar Terminal to Rewa

A direct train links Anand Vihar Terminal in Delhi with Rewa station. There is no direct train from New Delhi station, so plan to board at Anand Vihar. The journey takes around 14 to 15 hours.

About 730 km from Delhi

Driving takes roughly 9 to 10 hours without long stops, and a hired cab is another option. Bus and cab combinations are possible but take closer to 12 or 13 hours.

Another way in is through Satna by train or Jabalpur by air, with a train or road journey on to Rewa.

Need a hand with travel plans? Message us on WhatsApp at +91 70005 43658.
